3b2916e79f85c821.description: About the Role Acuative Middle East is seeking a Direct Liquid Cooling (DLC) Resident Engineer to provide on-site technical support, operational management, and maintenance for Supermicro Direct Liquid Cooling infrastructure. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The engineer will serve as the primary on-site technical representative, ensuring the reliability, availability, and optimal performance of liquid cooling systems within strategic customer data centers. Key Responsibilities The Direct Liquid Cooling Resident Engineer will manage on-site technical operations, incident resolution, and preventive maintenance, working closely with Supermicro's global services and customer data center teams. Act as the primary on-site technical resource for the customer's Direct Liquid Cooling environment. Monitor and maintain Cooling Distribution Units (CDUs), pumps, manifolds, hoses, racks, sensors, and associated cooling infrastructure. Perform daily inspections and routine preventive maintenance, verifying system operating parameters such as temperatures, flow rates, and pressure levels. Respond promptly to DLC system alarms, failures, leaks, and temperature abnormalities, performing initial diagnosis and troubleshooting. Coordinate with Supermicro engineering and remote technical support for advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA). Conduct scheduled system health checks and identify potential equipment failures and operational risks. Work directly with customer data center operations and facility management teams, providing regular technical updates. Maintain accurate service records, equipment history, and maintenance logs, documenting incidents and corrective actions. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates must possess a strong background in data center cooling technologies and mission-critical infrastructure operations. 5-10 years of experience in a relevant technical role. Strong knowledge of data center cooling technologies, mechanical and thermal systems. Experience with mission-critical infrastructure operations. Ability to perform hands-on technical tasks and troubleshooting. Proficiency in incident coordination and resolution. Capability to support continuous improvement initiatives. Preferred Technical Knowledge Experience in the following areas will be considered an advantage: Supermicro liquid cooling infrastructure. Direct-to-chip liquid cooling technologies. Cooling Distribution Units (CDUs) and coolant distribution networks. Pump systems, heat exchangers, and liquid cooling circuits. Temperature, pressure, and flow monitoring. Leak detection systems and liquid cooling safety procedures. Data center thermal management and high-density rack environments. Server and GPU infrastructure. Preventive maintenance and mission-critical incident management. Work Environment This role involves working on-site within strategic customer data centers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Resident Engineer will collaborate with various internal and external teams, including Supermicro's global Services organization, engineering teams, Technical Account Managers, Field Engineers, Service Desk, Logistics, and customer data center operations teams. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3b4fc1122fd9a219.description: About the Controlling Trainee Program Hitachi Energy is offering a 6-month Controlling Trainee program in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, providing support for financial control and reporting of manufacturing projects from quotation through delivery and closeout. The program aims to develop financial understanding, commercial awareness, analytical skills, and professional communication within a manufacturing environment. Successful performance during the training may lead to a permanent opportunity as a Project Analyst. Role Overview The Controlling Trainee will support project cost management and accounting practices, working closely with project managers, engineering, procurement, and production teams. This involves protecting project margins, improving forecast accuracy, and ensuring compliant revenue recognition. The role focuses on integrating financial control with operational processes to maintain fiscal integrity throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Support in setting up project budgets, cost structures, and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) in the ERP system, and maintain baseline versus current budget with the Project Manager. Monitor actual costs (material, labor, subcontract, overhead) against budget and identify variances. Prepare monthly Estimate-at-Completion (EAC) and Cost-to-Complete forecasts with project managers. Track and report project margin, cash flow, and working capital (Work In Progress, billings, advances). Support month-end closing activities. Assist with statutory, internal, and external audits by providing documentation and analysis. Produce monthly project performance reports, margin analyses, and management commentary. Contribute to the budget, rolling forecast, and order backlog reporting. Act as the finance lead on project reviews. Ensure compliance with internal controls, approval processes, and company policies. Work in accordance with company requirements for safety, quality, integrity, confidentiality, and governance. Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Required Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Company Values The successful candidate will embody Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility for their actions while demonstrating respect, collaboration, and care for colleagues, customers, and the business. Application Information This is a full-time training opportunity with potential for permanent employment based on performance. Salary details are not disclosed.

3b5f45f9c355dda7.description: About the Role Al Murjan Smart Lines (MSL) is seeking an Elevator Technician to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of elevators, escalators, and related vertical transportation equipment. The technician will ensure that all systems operate safely and reliably, adhering to applicable codes and company standards. The position requires 2-5 years of experience in the field. Key Responsibilities Perform scheduled preventive maintenance on traction, hydraulic, and MRL elevators and escalators, including lubrication, adjustments, cleaning, and inspections. Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, electronic, and control system faults. Respond to service calls, callbacks, breakdowns, and passenger entrapments, including on-call duties. Conduct safety tests and inspections in accordance with applicable codes and manufacturer recommendations. Adjust and test door equipment, brakes, governors, buffers, leveling, and other safety devices. Replace defective components and complete repairs to a high standard while minimizing downtime. Maintain accurate service reports, maintenance logs, and documentation. Follow all safety procedures, including LOTO, fall protection, hoistway safety, and electrical safety. Communicate professionally with customers and building management regarding equipment status. Keep tools, test equipment, and the service vehicle in excellent condition. Support modernization or installation work when required. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma or equivalent; a technical diploma or vocational training in an electrical or mechanical field is preferred. Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in elevator and escalator maintenance and repair. Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record. Good knowledge of elevator safety codes, including EN 81 and SASO standards. Ability to read electrical schematics and mechanical drawings. Physical ability to work in machine rooms, pits, hoistways, and at heights. Willingness to work on-call, overtime, and emergency shifts. Preferred Skills and Experience Experience with major brands such as Otis, KONE, Schindler, ThyssenKrupp, Mitsubishi, and Fujitec. Knowledge of microprocessor controllers and VVVF drives. Relevant technical certification, where available. Strong troubleshooting and customer service skills. Compensation and Benefits MSL offers a competitive salary based on qualifications and experience. The company provides a service vehicle, tools, and equipment as applicable. Additional benefits include medical insurance, a transportation allowance, annual leave, and training opportunities. Work Environment This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to work with a growing vertical transportation company. The position requires a commitment to safety and professional communication with clients and building management.

3b923079976d064d.description: About the Role Robert Walters is partnering with a leading organization in the automotive sector to appoint a Digital Transformation Manager Automotive. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern Region, and involves leading a significant, enterprise-wide digital and technology transformation program. The role focuses on modernizing technology capabilities, improving operational efficiency, and driving business-wide transformation within the automotive sector. Role Overview Reporting to senior leadership, the Digital Transformation Manager will take ownership of a complex, multi-year transformation agenda. This strategic initiative involves a comprehensive overhaul of the organization's technology landscape, enterprise systems, and core business processes. Key areas of focus include the transformation of dealer management capabilities, ERP modernization, supply chain, logistics, distribution, and digital commerce. Key Responsibilities Leading large-scale, enterprise-wide digital transformation programs across business applications and core operational systems. Driving the modernization of enterprise ERP platforms and associated business systems. Leading the transformation of dealer management systems and processes, covering dealer operations, distribution, sales, retail, and aftersales capabilities. Overseeing technology transformation across supply chain, logistics, inventory management, and distribution operations. Driving the development and enhancement of digital commerce and customer-facing technology capabilities. Working closely with senior business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify process gaps, and translate business requirements into effective technology solutions. Driving business process re-engineering, systems integration, data transformation, and operational improvement. Establishing strong program governance and PMO structures to ensure effective delivery. Managing a portfolio of projects through project managers and internal delivery teams, ensuring alignment on timelines, budgets, risks, and outcomes. Providing senior stakeholders with visibility of program progress, delivery risks, and key milestones. Ensuring effective adoption of new technologies and processes across the organization. Candidate Qualifications and Experience A proven track record of delivering at least two significant, large-scale, multi-year enterprise transformation programs. Strong experience leading complex ERP transformations and enterprise systems modernization, including major enterprise ERP platforms such as SAP and managing transitions from legacy technology environments. Experience transforming dealer management systems, dealer networks, or automotive distribution operations. A strong understanding of automotive business processes, ideally covering dealer operations, vehicle distribution, sales, retail, and aftersales. Exposure to complex supply chain and logistics environments. Experience in FMCG, retail, or pharmaceutical sectors will also be considered. Strong understanding of enterprise technology delivery, data, systems architecture, and integration challenges. Experience establishing or managing PMO functions, program governance, and project delivery methodologies. Familiarity with project delivery tools and methodologies, including Jira, DevOps, and Agile delivery environments. Required Experience Candidates should possess over 10 years of relevant experience in transformation roles, combining strong technical understanding with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and drive complex business change. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

3b9888e6aba9b09a.description: About Botanica Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global's destinations. The company focuses on integrating new species with local flora and benefits from shared strategic goals within the Red Sea Global group. Botanica operates over 1 million square meters, cultivating over 5 million plants since 2020, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. The Role of Director Commercial Botanica is seeking a Director Commercial to lead its commercial function in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves driving profitable, contracted revenue across all business lines, including plant and tree supply, contract growing, nursery services, horticultural soil, indoor plants and flowers, agricultural consulting, and landscape maintenance services. The Director Commercial will own the commercial strategy, pricing, tendering, client contracts, and key accounts for both internal Red Sea Global clients and external developments. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the 3–5 year commercial strategy and annual revenue plan, aligned with Botanica's business plan and RSG Group priorities. Define the product and service portfolio and pricing architecture for each business line. Lead market research and competitor benchmarking to identify new segments and services. Manage the opportunity pipeline across internal RSG clients and external developments, including hotel operators, developers, and government entities. Chair bid/no-bid reviews, lead tender strategy, and prepare technical and commercial proposals. Own client relationships for all key accounts, maintaining account plans, SLAs, and periodic performance reviews. Lead negotiation, execution, and renewal of client contracts, managing variations, change orders, and claims. Ensure monthly invoices are supported by verified service evidence and manage account-level collections. Lead marketing plans to position Botanica as a trusted supplier, overseeing the plant catalogue, sales collateral, and digital presence. Build and lead the commercial team, setting objectives, KPIs, and succession plans, including Saudization targets. Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, processes, and standards. Apply and champion safety, quality, and environmental management systems. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of relevant professional experience. Proven ability to lead commercial functions and drive revenue growth. Experience in commercial strategy, pricing, tendering, and contract management. Familiarity with market research, competitor benchmarking, and business development. Strong negotiation and client relationship management skills. Understanding of financial aspects related to revenue, billing, and collections. Experience in marketing and brand positioning. Leadership experience in building and managing commercial teams. Work Environment and Context Botanica operates as an integrated landscape company with two primary revenue streams: project-based product sales (plants, trees, soil, indoor plants and flowers) and recurring services (landscape maintenance, nursery management, and consulting). The Director Commercial will serve both internal clients within Red Sea Global and external developments, including hotel operators, developers, and government entities. The role requires balancing growth objectives with the delivery capabilities of the production units and proactively addressing commercial risks such as client concentration, price pressure on maintenance renewals, and scope creep. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3bbdf88922f618ac.description: About the Role كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer (OHPL/OHTL) to join their team. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience, specifically 12+ years in overhead line and transmission line engineering. The successful candidate will lead engineering and design activities for large Oil & Gas, hydrocarbon, utility, and infrastructure projects. Key Responsibilities Lead a team of 5 to 8 electrical engineers and designers focused on OHPL/OHTL engineering and design. Develop discipline work plans for OHPL/OHTL activities, including route development, plan & profile layouts, tower/pole spotting, clearance verification, and Sag & Tension calculations. Prepare work-hour estimates for OHPL/OHTL engineering, design, and associated project deliverables. Develop and review OHPL/OHTL design calculations and deliverables, such as PLS-CADD models, conductor/earth wire/OPGW selection, plan & profile drawings, Sag & Tension calculations, structural lists, loading criteria, clearance checks, and crossing details. Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) level technical leadership and guidance to project teams and clients on complete OHPL/OHTL design. Prepare/review Material Requisitions (MR) and Technical Bid Evaluations (TBE), and perform detailed Vendor NMR reviews for OHPL/OHTL equipment & hardware, along with related electrical equipment. Lead technical presentations and design reviews with Clients and their representatives, including the presentation of complete OHPL/OHTL design. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12+ years of experience in overhead line and transmission line engineering. Strong technical expertise in PLS-CADD, Sag & Tension analysis, conductor and earth-wire/OPGW selection, tower/pole spotting, electrical clearances, loading cases, line routing, and preparation/review of OHTL design deliverables. Experience in Conceptual Design, Front-End Engineering Design (FEED), and detailed engineering. Proven capability to lead a multidisciplinary team of electrical engineers and designers. Key Interactions This role involves regular interaction with other disciplines, technical vendors, project management, and client representatives to ensure project success and alignment on design specifications. Work Type This is a full-time position.

3bc89a5e691c2adf.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking an experienced IT Solution Analyst – Business Solutions (eCommerce & Marketplace) to support its eMarketPlace platform and related digital commerce solutions. This full-time role involves translating business requirements into scalable technology solutions, supporting solution design and implementation, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver effective eCommerce and marketplace capabilities. Key Responsibilities Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solution specifications. Support the design, implementation, and enhancement of eMarketPlace and eCommerce solutions. Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand processes, challenges, and future needs. Define solution approaches that align with business objectives, enterprise architecture, security, integration, and technology standards. Support the implementation and optimization of CommerceTools and other commerce-related platforms. Work with solution architects, developers, product owners, vendors, and business teams throughout the solution lifecycle. Analyze existing systems and processes to identify opportunities for improvement, automation, and digital transformation. Support MACH architecture principles, including Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, and Headless approaches. Support guided buying capabilities and digital procurement/customer purchasing journeys. Define and document requirements for eCatalogue solutions, product information, pricing, availability, and related marketplace capabilities. Develop functional specifications, user stories, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria. Support integration requirements between the marketplace/eCommerce platform and enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, PIM, payment, logistics, and identity. Participate in solution evaluations, technical discussions, proof-of-concepts, and vendor assessments. Work with development and testing teams to ensure delivered solutions meet business and functional requirements. Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards. Prepare solution documentation and maintain relevant technical and functional artifacts. Provide ongoing support and continuous improvement for eMarketPlace and commerce solutions. Required Qualifications and Experience 5–10 years of relevant experience in IT business solutions, solution analysis, eCommerce, digital commerce, marketplace, or related domains. Strong experience with eMarketPlace solutions and commerce platforms. Hands-on or strong functional experience with CommerceTools. 3bf7f29c1c50084a.description: About Tata Consultancy Services Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization that has partnered with global businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive-powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology, and engineering services and solutions, delivered through its Location Independent Agile™ delivery model. As part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS operates with over 616,171 consultants across 53 countries. The Role: IT Asset Officer TCS is seeking an IT Asset Officer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing the lifecycle of IT assets, ensuring accurate inventory, compliance, and cost-effective procurement and disposal. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Maintain accurate records of IT assets, including hardware, software, and licenses, using inventory management tools such as SCCM, ServiceNow, or custom databases. Conduct regular physical audits to verify stock levels and reconcile any discrepancies. Monitor stock levels of IT equipment (laptops, desktops, peripherals) and initiate replenishment orders as needed. Organize and manage IT storage areas, ensuring proper labeling and secure storage. Track IT assets from procurement through disposal, including deployment, transfers, and decommissioning. Update asset registers with essential details such as serial numbers, warranty information, and user assignments. Coordinate with procurement and vendors to ensure timely delivery of IT equipment. Ensure compliance with software agreements and license terms to prevent penalties. Generate reports on asset utilization, depreciation, and end-of-life schedules. Assist in internal and external audits by providing accurate asset documentation. Validate purchase requests against inventory needs to prevent overstocking or understocking. Identify cost-saving opportunities, such as bulk purchases or the use of refurbished equipment. Follow secure data-wiping and disposal procedures for retired assets. Collaborate with e-waste vendors for environmentally compliant disposal and recycling. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in IT asset management or a related field. Work Environment This is an on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring regular lifting and shifting of IT equipment. The role involves collaboration with IT, Finance, and Procurement teams.

3ba1005a228e50fc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أباريل للتجارة عن مدير متجر للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير المتجر مسؤولية الإشراف على الأهداف التشغيلية للمتجر، وتخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة العمليات اليومية لضمان الكفاءة والفعالية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان توافر الموارد اللازمة وسير العمليات بما يتوافق مع الخطط الموضوعة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على وضع الأهداف والخطط التشغيلية للمتجر. تطوير وتنسيق الإجراءات التشغيلية لموظفي المتجر وتحديد مهامهم ومسؤولياتهم وتوزيعها. المتابعة العامة لأداء المتجر والأنشطة اليومية، مع التأكد من توفير الدعم والمعلومات اللازمة لفرق العمل. ضمان توفير الموارد المطلوبة لتنفيذ الأنشطة وملاءمتها لمعايير الجودة المعتمدة. مراقبة مستوى وكميات السلع والبضائع في المتجر والتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية لتنفيذ طلبات الشراء. التأكد من التزام الموظفين بالتوجيهات والمهام المسندة إليهم وأدائهم الفعال لها. ضمان تنفيذ إدارة المتجر لكافة الأنظمة والقرارات المتعلقة، والتواصل مع الموظفين لتعزيز فهمهم للمستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المتاجر أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على وضع الأهداف التشغيلية وتطوير الخطط الاستراتيجية. فهم قوي لإدارة المخزون وسلاسل الإمداد. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. القدرة على تنظيم وتوزيع المهام بفعالية. مهارات تواصل قوية لتعزيز فهم الموظفين للأنظمة والقرارات. القدرة على مراقبة الأداء وضمان الالتزام بمعايير الجودة. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم.

3b0af8143cb457f5.description: About the Role ABIS is seeking an experienced professional for the role of Operation (SMP). This full-time position involves operating, monitoring, and controlling plant equipment and production processes within Oil & Gas, petrochemical, and refinery facilities. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor plant operations to ensure safe, efficient, and continuous production in accordance with established operating procedures. Perform plant start-up, shutdown, and routine operational activities. Operate and monitor various process systems, including oil separation, fractionation, hydrogen processing, and isomerization units. Control plant operating parameters using control panels and distributed control systems. Support refinery operations, terminal activities, and tank farm operations. Conduct routine inspections of plant equipment, pipelines, valves, and process systems. Monitor water treatment systems and ensure compliance with operational requirements. Identify operational abnormalities, troubleshoot process issues, and coordinate corrective actions with maintenance teams. Support well services, wireline operations, and well completion activities as needed. Coordinate with field operators, console operators, and control room personnel to maintain safe plant operations. Ensure compliance with operational safety procedures, environmental regulations, and company standards. Maintain accurate operational logs, shift reports, and production records. Respond to process alarms, equipment failures, and emergency situations according to established procedures. Experience Requirements Candidates for this position must possess a minimum of 10 years of experience in operating and monitoring plant equipment and production processes within the Oil & Gas, petrochemical, or refinery sectors. Work Type This is a full-time position.

3b2712127a10a74b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية للتسويق أسواق المزرعة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المحاسبية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المالية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود المحاسبية لضمان دقة السجلات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. مهارة في إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. مهارة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق الشركة السعودية للتسويق أسواق المزرعة في الخفجي بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بالمهام المحاسبية اليومية لضمان سير العمليات المالية بكفاءة ودقة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في بيئة ديناميكية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

3b41b8ffcee726b4.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform designed for emerging markets. With over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, the company serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA, focusing on sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. Unifonic is recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The Sales Team The Sales team at Unifonic is responsible for driving revenue and serving as trusted consultants to customers. The team includes experts in account management, business development, and customer service, collaborating with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. Role Overview: Strategic Account Manager As a Strategic Account Manager based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, you will manage and expand a portfolio of high-value enterprise accounts within regulated industries such as government, financial services, telecommunications, and large enterprises. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders, driving customer retention and revenue growth, and ensuring long-term customer success. You will develop strategic account plans, identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, lead executive-level account governance, and manage customer risks and escalations. The role involves close coordination with internal sales, technical, delivery, customer success, and support teams to meet customer needs and achieve measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts. Achieve annual recurring revenue (ARR), expansion, upsell, and retention targets. Develop and execute account plans for key customers. Identify and drive cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the product portfolio. Lead contract renewals and commercial negotiations. Build trusted relationships with C-level, business, and technical stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic customers. Conduct executive business reviews and governance meetings. Ensure customer objectives align with company capabilities and roadmap. Monitor customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and business outcomes. Manage escalations and coordinate resolution across internal teams. Improve retention and reduce churn risk through proactive engagement. Drive successful onboarding and service expansion initiatives. Prepare quarterly account reviews, forecasts, and business plans. Maintain accurate account data, opportunity tracking, and forecasting within CRM. Coordinate with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Delivery, Finance, and Legal teams. 3bb0a5266f7e64be.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة الخليجية لصناعة الملح عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة عمليات الشراء، من تحديد الاحتياجات إلى استلام المواد، ويعد فرصة ممتازة للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة أو الخريجين الجدد. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مندوب المشتريات مسؤولية تنفيذ جميع جوانب عملية الشراء، بما في ذلك: دراسة وتدقيق طلبات الشراء الواردة من الأقسام المعنية، والتأكد من مطابقتها للوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. إجراء عمليات الشراء المباشر للمواد والسلع المطلوبة وفقاً للإجراءات واللوائح المعتمدة. تجهيز وثائق المناقصات، وتوزيعها على الموردين المحتملين، وجمع عروض التوريد. المشاركة في تشكيل فرق دراسة العروض ومتابعة عملها، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق نتائج الدراسة لضمان الدقة والامتثال. إرساء طلبات الشراء على العرض الأنسب بناءً على اللوائح والتنظيمات المعمول بها. استلام المشتريات والتحقق من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات المتفق عليها. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات لضمان صحتها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيق وحفظ جميع المستندات والسجلات المتعلقة بالمشتريات. نطاق العمل يغطي هذا الدور شراء المواد والسلع من خلال آليات الشراء المباشر والمناقصات. كما يشمل متابعة استلام المشتريات، والتحقق من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق المطالبات المالية ذات الصلة وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المشتريات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق اللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالمشتريات. مهارات جيدة في التدقيق والمتابعة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتوفر بيئة عمل منظمة تدعم النمو المهني في مجال المشتريات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

3b934fc259c003ca.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking an Aircraft Push Back Driver to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the safe and efficient operation of aircraft pushback tractors and towing equipment, ensuring compliance with Swissport operational procedures, airline requirements, airport regulations, and aviation safety standards. The position is critical for maintaining safe aircraft movement and operational punctuality. Key Responsibilities Perform safe aircraft pushback and towing operations using authorized ground support equipment (GSE). Follow approved aircraft pushback procedures and instructions from ground communication personnel. Ensure correct connection and disconnection of tow bars or towbarless tractors. Maintain safe clearance from aircraft, vehicles, equipment, and airport infrastructure. Support on-time aircraft departures while adhering to safety standards. Maintain clear communication throughout pushback operations. Assist with other ramp-related duties when assigned, provided appropriate training and authorization are in place. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Ability to operate aircraft pushback tractors and towing equipment safely and efficiently. Knowledge of aviation safety standards and ground handling procedures. Strong commitment to safety and compliance. 3bf78ff290962e0a.description: The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for leading and executing enterprise-wide migration initiatives from public to private IP addressing across applications, databases, servers, and network devices. Execute the migration from public to private IP addresses in a secure and controlled manner, while maintaining continuous operation of business-critical applications and services. • Coordinate with security, systems, application, and operations teams to align firewall rules, routing, NAT, DNS, and access controls with the new private addressing model. • Perform post-migration validation and testing to confirm service availability, performance, and network stability. • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation for all migration phases, including implemented changes, encountered issues, root causes, and applied solutions. • Assess and analyze all DNS records to identify unused, obsolete, or outdated entries. • Classify DNS records based on criticality, activity level, and operational validity. • Remove or update invalid, obsolete, or unnecessary DNS entries in accordance with approved change procedures. • Ensure that DNS cleanup activities do not impact applications, services, or end users. • Establish periodic review procedures to maintain the accuracy and health of DNS records on an ongoing basis. • Document all DNS review, cleanup activities, and applied changes for audit, compliance, and operational reference. • Strong expertise in enterprise network design, IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6), subnetting, and routing protocols. • Hands-on experience with IP address migration projects in large-scale environments (on-prem, cloud, or hybrid). • Solid knowledge of firewalls, load balancers, DNS, NAT, VPNs, and network security controls. • Experience working with high-availability and mission-critical environments, ensuring zero or minimal downtime. • Ability to analyze complex application-to-network dependencies. • Familiarity with change management, rollback planning, and disaster recovery practices. • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field • Relevant certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, Infoblox Technical Certifications or equivalent are highly prefer.
